retro/jxl.nim -- where it comes from
====================================

retro/jxl.nim is Nim written for retro; nothing in this directory is compiled
into it. It reads and writes JPEG XL as ISO/IEC 18181-1 describes it, and was
written with three implementations at hand, whose tables and constants it
carries (the quantization and upsampling weights, the AFV basis, the order of
the 8-bit output's dither, the spline and noise arithmetic, ...) and whose
code it follows in places:

  libjxl     https://github.com/libjxl/libjxl     BSD-3-Clause (below), with
             Google's patent grant for JPEG XL (libjxl's PATENTS file)
  jxl-oxide  https://github.com/tirr-c/jxl-oxide  MIT (below) or Apache-2.0
  J40        https://github.com/lifthrasiir/j40   public domain, or MIT-0

The test files in tests/data/jxl were written by libjxl, except splines.jxl
and splines-first-frame.jxl, from https://github.com/libjxl/testdata
(CC BY 4.0, the JPEG XL Project Authors).
